source_unit: published December 2025 WBNS estimates; adults and family outcomes, with older-adult subgroup definitions preserved
sample_boundary: The brief uses December 2025 WBNS data. Older-adult estimates exclude institutional settings; subgroup comparisons reflect different need and disability composition.
interpretation: Unmet assistance co-occurs with food, health-care, housing, and utility hardship, but the published cross-sectional estimates do not identify a dated service episode, alternatives, causal direction, remedy, recovery, trust, or action.
vintage_boundary: The WBNS sample expanded to include approximately 2,500 adults age 65 and older in 2025; do not pool all-age 2025 estimates with 2017–2024 working-age estimates without harmonization.
storage_boundary: Uses published web text and existing local metadata; no microdata or bulk file downloaded.
